notes.title: MULTIVERSE MERCENARIES LAUNCH OCT 14TH
notes.notes:
A 2D game that features: 
[list]
[*] Satisfying and powerful sword combat
[/list]
[list]
[*] Precise and intense shooter combat
[/list]
[list]
[*] 4 randomly generated levels all in distinct environments with groovy tracks in the background
[/list]
[list]
[*] 4 different devastating enemies that interact with each other
[/list]
[list]
[*] In-game money that can be used to buy items that power up your character
[/list]
[list]
[*] Exciting platforming with unique obstacles
[/list]

[b]ALL FOR FREE!!!!![/b]
